analysis:
Examined both configuration excerpts, file metadata, SDK gitlink update and bridge patch against the canonical threat index and selected T-041 detail. docs/reference/configuration.md:594 adds an explanation that BF16 GPT-OSS activations do not require constant widening; it changes no configuration gate. EngineV2Bridge.swift:132–136 changes only the explanation of kvBytesPerToken, identifying observed per-layer K/V types and EngineV2SlotFactory.slotKVBytesPerToken as the sizing source. Neither visible textual change establishes a security regression. Surrounding cache, media, authorization, environment and qualification documentation is unchanged in the supplied complete range maps; differences between that surrounding documentation and historical T-041 claims are not attributable to these edits.
The libs/mlx-swift-lm gitlink at head line 1 advances from 0351444e… to f2eb29b8…, but its implementation delta is not supplied. This is a material coverage limit, not evidence of a missing control. Integration must examine that SDK delta together with slotKVBytesPerToken, native cache allocation types, process reservations and heartbeat capacity derivation to verify that the documented dtype-dependent accounting matches actual allocations. Also check any changed SDK cache scope/lifetime and staging behavior (A-001, T-028, T-041, TB-007), output arithmetic/model integrity (T-007, T-027), cancellation (T-010) and resource bounds. The visible comments alone cannot validate those contracts or determine whether the dependency update affects them. No supported finding is established within this source scope.
